summary: Recent updates in the Media Control and Session area of Firefox focus on improving the way audio and video playback is managed during interruptions, such as phone calls or incoming messages. One key enhancement is proper handling of the media element's mute state, ensuring it automatically clears when playback stops, leading to a more seamless user experience. Additionally, testing has been introduced to better support suspending and resuming audio during these interruptions, which is crucial for maintaining audio quality and user convenience. These changes help ensure that users can enjoy uninterrupted media experiences when navigating everyday scenarios. **This matters because it enhances user interaction and control over media during common interruptions, aligning Firefox with modern usage patterns.**
